The research's serving content is M-FALCON (amortizing attention across candidates WITHIN a request, §2.3), FP8/INT4 quantization ladder (§8.4), and context parallelism (training-side, §2.3) — nothing on cross-request user-state caching or KV-cache compression. §13a lists 'serving-time user-embedding refresh' as a gap but never connects it to caching.
